# API reference

Solar lucky-imaging stacker. All paths are relative to the server's data root. Version 0.7.1 of the document; licence GPL-3.0-or-later.

The narrative guide, with examples and the security model, is in [The API](../user-guide/api.md). The machine-readable document is [openapi.json](openapi.json), and a running server serves it at `/api/v1/openapi.json`.

All paths below are relative to `/api/v1`.

## Operations

### `GET /captures/frame`

**One frame of a capture as an auto-stretched 8-bit greyscale PNG.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | query | string | yes | Capture path relative to the data root. |
| `index` | query | integer | no | Frame index (default 0). |
| `channel` | query | [ChannelArg](#channelarg) | no | `r`, `g`, `b` or `lum` (default) for Bayer captures. |
| `max_width` | query | integer | no | Downscale to at most this width (16 to 8192). |
| `bayer` | query | string | no | Bayer handling, as for jobs: `auto` (default), `none` or a pattern. |
| `bit_depth` | query | integer (int32) | no | Bits per sample instead of the SER header's. |
| `endian` | query | string | no | `little` or `big`. |
| `flip_rows` | query | boolean | no | Read the rows bottom to top. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | 8-bit greyscale PNG | `image/png` |

### `GET /jobs`

**Remembered jobs, oldest first. The newest 100 finished jobs are kept.**

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | OK | `application/json`: array of [JobView](#jobview) |

### `POST /jobs`

**Queue a stack. Answers `202` with the job; poll it or follow its events.**

Request body:

* `application/json`: [JobRequest](#jobrequest)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | Accepted | `application/json`: [JobView](#jobview) |
| 429 | queue full (`queue_full`) | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |

### `GET /jobs/{id}`

**One job: state, stage, progress, timings and summary.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer (int64) | yes | job id |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | OK | `application/json`: [JobView](#jobview) |
| 404 | unknown job id | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |

### `DELETE /jobs/{id}`

**Cancel a queued or running job, or forget a finished one.**

A finished job's output file stays on disk.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer (int64) | yes | job id |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | cancellation requested | `application/json`: [JobView](#jobview) |
| 204 | finished job forgotten |  |
| 404 | unknown job id | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |

### `GET /jobs/{id}/events`

**WebSocket stream of job events: a snapshot, then state and progress messages.**

The server closes the stream after the final state message.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer (int64) | yes | job id |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 101 | WebSocket; text frames are JobEvent JSON |  |

### `POST /mosaic`

**Join panels of the Sun into a full-disc mosaic.**

Stack every panel first, with the same settings, using ordinary jobs. The
request runs to the end before it answers.

Request body:

* `application/json`: [MosaicRequest](#mosaicrequest)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | OK | `application/json`: [MosaicResponse](#mosaicresponse) |
| 409 | `output` exists and `overwrite` is false (`output_exists`) | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |
| 422 | bad settings, panels that do not match, or no time for a derotation | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |

### `GET /presets/{id}/lut`

**A preset's colour table as a file other programs read.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | preset id, see `GET /presets` |
| `format` | query | string | no | `cube` (default), `csv`, `imagej` or `png`. |
| `size` | query | integer | no | Entries, 2 to 4096 (default 256; an `imagej` table always has 256). |
| `invert` | query | boolean | no | Invert before colouring. |
| `strength` | query | number (float) | no | Mix of colour and grey, 0 to 1 (default 1). |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | the table: a .cube, .csv, ImageJ .lut or a PNG strip |  |
| 404 | no such preset | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |
| 422 | a bad format, size or strength | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |

### `POST /solar-derotation`

**Bring images of the Sun to one time by its differential rotation.**

Each image is derotated on its own, about the disc fitted to it; the
result is not shifted, so use the time-lapse (or a mosaic) to register them.

Request body:

* `application/json`: [SolarDerotationRequest](#solarderotationrequest)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | OK | `application/json`: [SolarDerotationResponse](#solarderotationresponse) |
| 409 | a result exists and `overwrite` is false (`output_exists`) | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |
| 422 | bad settings, no time, or no clear disc | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |

### `POST /timelapse`

**Register stacked images to each other and write a time-lapse: numbered
frames, a registration table and a movie.**

Stack every capture first, with the same settings, using ordinary jobs. The
request runs to the end before it answers; a long series with an MP4 can take
a while.

Request body:

* `application/json`: [TimelapseRequest](#timelapserequest)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | OK | `application/json`: [TimelapseResponse](#timelapseresponse) |
| 409 | `output` already holds a time-lapse and `overwrite` is false (`output_exists`) | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |
| 422 | bad settings, fewer than two inputs, or an input that is not a stacked image | `application/json`: [ErrorEnvelope](#errorenvelope) |

### `GET /version`

**Server version, backend availability, limits and whether a token is required.**

The GPU is probed once, on first use.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | OK | `application/json`: [VersionInfo](#versioninfo) |

## Schemas

### AlignmentSummary

Global alignment: the method that ran, why, and its confidence.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `confidence` | number (float), may be null | no | Mean confidence of the frames, 0 to 1. Absent when it was not measured. |
| `confidence_min` | number (float), may be null | no | Least confidence of any frame, 0 to 1. |
| `fallbacks` | integer | yes | Frames that wanted the limb fit but were aligned by phase correlation. |
| `limb` | array of number (float), may be null | no | Fitted limb of the reference: centre x, centre y and radius, pixels. |
| `method` | string | yes | What ran: `limb` or `phase`. |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why, in a sentence (for `auto`, whether the full disc was in view). |
| `requested` | string | yes | What `config.align` asked for: `auto`, `phase` or `limb`. |
| `sampled` | boolean | yes | The confidence comes from a sample of the frames (a GPU run). |

### AutoApSummary

What automatic alignment points chose and what they were based on.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arcsec_per_pixel` | number (float), may be null | no | Image scale from the fitted limb, arcseconds per pixel. Absent when there was no limb. |
| `search_radius` | integer | yes | Search radius around the global shift, pixels. |
| `size` | integer | yes | Window edge, pixels. |
| `step` | integer | yes | Distance between window centres, pixels. |
| `text` | string | yes | The choice in a sentence. |
| `warp_px` | number (float), may be null | no | Local warp of the seeing, pixels (root mean square distance of an alignment point's shift from its frame's median). Absent when too few points locked. |

### CalibrationConfig

Calibration masters for a job. Each path is relative to the data root and
names a master file (FITS, from `helia calibrate`) or raw calibration
frames to build one from (a SER, AVI or FITS file, or a folder of them).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bad_pixels` | string, may be null | no | Bad-pixel map: a FITS map from `helia calibrate`, or a text file with an `x y` pair (from 0, top-left) on each line. |
| `bias` | string, may be null | no | Master bias, or bias captures. Only used with `scale_dark`. |
| `combine` | string | no | How frames are combined into a master: `median`, `sigma` or `sigma:K`. Default `sigma`. Default `"sigma"`. |
| `cosmetic` | boolean | no | Without `bad_pixels`, find the hot pixels of the dark and the cold ones of the flat and correct them. Default `true`. Default `true`. |
| `dark` | string, may be null | no | Master dark, or dark captures. |
| `displaced` | string, may be null | no | Captures of the Sun at many places on the sensor, to solve a flat from when there is no `flat` (self-calibration: dust and fringes included). The dark is taken off first. Excludes `flat`. |
| `flat` | string, may be null | no | Master flat, or flat captures. |
| `flat_dark` | string, may be null | no | Dark captures at the exposure of the flats, when `flat` is captures. |
| `scale_dark` | boolean | no | Scale the dark by the ratio of the exposures (read from the `SharpCap` sidecar of the capture). Default `false`. |

### CaptureInfo

Header information for a capture.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bayer` | string, may be null | no | Bayer pattern (`rggb` ...) when raw colour. |
| `bit_depth` | integer (int32) | yes | Bits per sample. |
| `codec` | string, may be null | no | Video codec (`h264`, ...), for video read through ffmpeg. |
| `colour` | string | yes | Pixel layout: `mono`, `bayer`, `rgb`, `bgr`, or `video` for compressed video, which ffmpeg converts to luminance or one colour channel. |
| `detection` | [DetectionInfo](#detectioninfo) or null | no |  |
| `effective` | [EffectiveInfo](#effectiveinfo) | yes | What Helia decodes the capture with, and where each value came from. |
| `format` | string | yes | `ser`, `avi`, or the extension of a video read through ffmpeg (`mp4`, `mov`, `mkv`, `webm`, `m4v`; also `avi` for a compressed AVI). |
| `fourcc` | string, may be null | no | AVI `FourCC`. |
| `frame_rate` | number (double), may be null | no | Frames per second, for video. |
| `frames` | integer | yes | Number of frames. |
| `header` | [SerHeaderInfo](#serheaderinfo) or null | no |  |
| `height` | integer (int32) | yes | Height in pixels. |
| `instrument` | string, may be null | no | SER instrument string. |
| `notices` | array of [NoticeInfo](#noticeinfo) | yes | What to tell the user about how the file was read. |
| `observer` | string, may be null | no | SER observer string. |
| `overrides` | array of string | yes | The overrides in force, as command-line flags. |
| `path` | string | yes | Capture path relative to the data root. |
| `quality_note` | string, may be null | no | Quality caveat when the input is lossy video, for example "lossy 8-bit 4:2:0 video (h264): fine for quick results, SER/AVI raw captures keep more detail". |
| `recommended` | [Recommended](#recommended) | yes | The settings a job would use if none were given. |
| `sidecar` | [SidecarInfo](#sidecarinfo) or null | no |  |
| `telescope` | string, may be null | no | SER telescope string. |
| `timestamps` | boolean, may be null | no | SER per-frame timestamps present. |
| `width` | integer (int32) | yes | Width in pixels. |

### DebayerArg

Demosaicing method.

One of `bilinear`, `mhc`.

### DerotateConfig

How the Sun's differential rotation is undone (`derotate` of a time-lapse,
and the settings of `POST /solar-derotation`); every field is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `celestial_north_up` | boolean | no | The images have celestial north up: solar north is turned by the position angle P at each image's time, on top of `north_angle_deg`. Default `false`. |
| `law` | string, may be null | no | `howard` (default), `snodgrass`, or `A,B,C`: degrees a day for `A + B sin^2 + C sin^4` of the latitude (`A` positive). |
| `mirror` | boolean | no | The images are mirror images (west on the left). Default `false`. |
| `north_angle_deg` | number (float) | no | Degrees counter-clockwise from the top of the image to solar north (default 0). Default `0.0`. |
| `raw_brightness` | boolean | no | Move the pixel values as they are, not the contrast against the limb darkening. Default `false`. |
| `to` | string, may be null | no | The time to bring every image to, UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss`). Default: the reference frame's time in a time-lapse, the middle time of the images in `POST /solar-derotation` (which also takes `first`, `middle` and `last`). |

### FieldRotationConfig

How to undo the field rotation of an altazimuth mount.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mirror` | boolean | no | The picture is a mirror image (an odd number of reflections): the turn is the other way. Default `false`. |
| `reference` | string, may be null | no | The orientation every frame is turned to: `middle` (default), `first` or `last`. |

### FieldRotationSummary

What undoing the field rotation did.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `altitude_deg` | number (double) | yes | Altitude of the Sun at the reference, degrees. |
| `frames_stamped` | integer | yes | Frames that had a timestamp of their own. |
| `limb_shift_px` | number (float), may be null | no | Displacement at the limb, pixels, of the frame that turned most; absent without a fitted limb. |
| `lines` | array of string | yes | The report in lines, as the command line prints it. |
| `max_turn_deg` | number (double) | yes | Largest turn applied to a frame, degrees. |
| `rate_deg_per_min` | number (double) | yes | Mean rate of rotation, degrees per minute. |
| `reference_angle_deg` | number (double) | yes | Parallactic angle at the reference, degrees. |
| `reference_time` | string | yes | The orientation every frame was turned to: the time of that frame, ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `span_deg` | number (double) | yes | Parallactic angle from the first frame to the last, degrees. |

### GranulationSummary

Granulation statistics of the stack (`helia measure`, the quality report).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arcsec_per_pixel` | number (float), may be null | no | Image scale, arcseconds per pixel (absent without a fitted limb). |
| `cell_diameter_px` | number (float) | yes | Mean diameter of whole granules, pixels. |
| `cell_pitch_px` | number (float) | yes | Mean spacing of granules, pixels. |
| `cutoff_freq` | number (float), may be null | no | Diffraction cut-off `D / lambda` in cycles per pixel; needs `aperture_mm` and a fitted limb. |
| `lines` | array of string | yes | The report in lines, as the command line prints it. |
| `resolved_freq` | number (float) | yes | Highest frequency (cycles per pixel) above 1% of the peak power. |
| `rms_contrast` | number (float) | yes | Standard deviation over mean of the flattened disc-centre region (a fraction, 0.04 is 4%). |
| `rolloff_freq` | number (float) | yes | Spatial frequency (cycles per pixel) where the noise-subtracted power spectrum has fallen to 10% of its peak. |

### JobConfig

The same knobs as `helia stack`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | string | no | How whole frames are aligned: `auto` (fit the solar limb when the full disc is in view and the fit is confident, else phase correlation), `phase`, or `limb`. The choice and its confidence come back in `summary.alignment`. Default `"auto"`. |
| `align_channels` | boolean | no | With `colour: "true"`, register red and blue to green (atmospheric dispersion). Default `true`. Default `true`. |
| `ap_auto` | boolean | no | Choose the alignment point size, spacing and search range from the image scale (the fitted limb) and the seeing (a probe of a dozen frames). Excludes `ap_size`; needs `multipoint`. What was chosen comes back in `summary.auto_ap`. Default `false`. |
| `ap_passes` | integer (int32), may be null | no | Alignment point passes, 1 or 2. 2 stacks once and measures the points again against that stack. Default 1; needs `multipoint`. |
| `ap_residual` | boolean | no | Measure the alignment points once more against the finished stack, for the residual figure of the `report` (`ap-residual.png`). Costs one more registration pass. Needs `multipoint`. Default `false`. |
| `ap_size` | integer, may be null | no | Alignment point size in pixels (8 to 1024). Absent: chosen from the image size. |
| `ap_smooth` | boolean | no | Replace alignment point shifts that disagree with their neighbours by the neighbours' median. Needs `multipoint`. Default `false`. |
| `aperture_mm` | number (float), may be null | no | Telescope aperture in millimetres, for the diffraction cut-off in `summary.granulation` and for `r0` in `summary.seeing`. |
| `autocrop` | boolean | no | Crop the result to the solar disc plus `autocrop_margin`, FITS too. A capture without a clear disc is left uncropped; `summary.crop` is then absent. Default `false`. |
| `autocrop_margin` | number (float), may be null | no | Margin of `autocrop` as a percentage of the disc radius, 0 to 200. Default 10. |
| `backend` | [BackendArg](#backendarg) | no | Compute backend. Default `"auto"`. |
| `bayer` | string | no | `auto`, `none`, `rggb`, `grbg`, `gbrg` or `bggr`. `auto` trusts the file's header, but checks a SER file labelled mono for a hidden Bayer mosaic and debayers when it finds one. `none` treats the frames as mono whatever the header says; a pattern forces it. Default `"auto"`. |
| `bit_depth` | integer (int32), may be null | no | Bits per sample instead of the SER header's (1 to 8 read one byte per pixel, 9 to 16 two). SER only. |
| `calibration` | [CalibrationConfig](#calibrationconfig) or null | no |  |
| `channel` | [ChannelArg](#channelarg) or null | no |  |
| `colour` | string, may be null | no | Colour of the output: `auto` (the preset in force), `mono`, a preset id, or `true`. `true` is true colour from a raw colour camera: red, green and blue stacked on one alignment, channels aligned, white balanced, written as an RGB TIFF or PNG or a three-plane FITS cube; it needs a Bayer capture and excludes `channel`, `invert` and `colour_strength`. The other looks colour a `.tif` or `.png` from the mono stack, and FITS output is mono and unaltered for them. Absent: the `preset`'s colours if one was given, else mono. |
| `colour_strength` | number (float) | no | Mix of colour and grey, 0 to 1. Default `1.0`. |
| `date` | string, may be null | no | When the capture was taken, UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss`), for a capture that does not hold its own time (an AVI or a video; a SER's time stamps are used otherwise). Gives P, B0 and L0 to `sunspots` and to the heliographic grids of `report`. |
| `debayer` | [DebayerArg](#debayerarg) | no | Demosaicing method. Default `"mhc"`. |
| `detect_overlay` | boolean | no | Look for burned-in text (a `SharpCap` timestamp) and mask it. Default `true`. |
| `disc_mask` | boolean | no | Fit the limb and place alignment points on the disc only. Default `true`. |
| `edits` | array of object | no | Further edits, applied in order after `sharpen`: objects with an `op` of `unsharp`, `wavelet`, `deconvolve`, `denoise`, `levels`, `curve`, `crop`, `rotate`, `flip` or `resize` and that operation's parameters (see the sharpening and adjustments page of the user guide). Unset parameters take their defaults. Default `[]`. |
| `endian` | string, may be null | no | Byte order of 16-bit samples instead of the SER header flag: `little` or `big`. SER only. |
| `exclude` | array of [Region](#region) | no | Rectangles to keep alignment and scoring off. They are flattened in every frame and so are flat in the result. Burned-in timestamps are found automatically (see `detect_overlay`). Default `[]`. |
| `field_rotation` | [FieldRotationConfig](#fieldrotationconfig) or null | no |  |
| `flatten` | string, may be null | no | Flatten the disc's limb darkening before anything else: `model` (divide by the fitted law) or `profile` (divide by the measured azimuthal median). Outside the limb nothing changes. It runs first, so `sharpen` and `edits` see flat contrast. A capture with no clear disc is left as it is and `summary.limb_darkening` is absent. |
| `flip_rows` | boolean | no | Read the rows bottom to top. SER only. Default `false`. |
| `grade` | string, may be null | no | Colour grading on top of the look: `hue=DEG,sat=S,gamma=G,black=B, white=W,r=R,g=G,b=B`, any of them (hue -180 to 180, sat 0 to 2, gamma 0.3 to 3, black 0 to 0.9, white 0.1 to 1, r, g and b channel curves 0.3 to 3). Absent: no grading. Not with `colour: "true"`. |
| `invert` | boolean | no | Invert before colouring (shows filaments and prominences). Default `false`. |
| `keep` | string, may be null | no | Share (`"25%"`) or count (`"500"`) of frames to keep. Default `25%`. |
| `keep_frames` | integer, may be null | no | Number of frames to keep; excludes `keep`. |
| `limb_law` | string, may be null | no | The limb-darkening law fitted to the stack and used by `flatten`: `linear`, `quadratic` (the default) or `neckel` (five terms). The fit comes back in `summary.limb_darkening` whether or not `flatten` is set. |
| `metric` | [MetricArg](#metricarg) | no | Frame ranking metric. Default `"gradient"`. |
| `multipoint` | boolean | no | Multi-point alignment; `false` is global alignment only. Default `true`. |
| `plugin_steps` | array of string | no | Steps of plugins to run, each `PLUGIN/STEP`, optionally followed by `:KEY=VALUE,KEY=VALUE` or `:{"json":"object"}` for its parameters and optionally preceded by `pre:` for an image step that runs before `sharpen` and `edits`. A `frame-op` step runs on every frame before it is scored; an `image-op` step on the stack (after `sharpen` and `edits` unless `pre:`); an `analyse` step on the result, and what it reports comes back in `summary.plugins`. The plugins must have been enabled on the server (`helia plugins enable`); a plugin that is off, changed or unknown, or a value outside the step's range, is a 422. They run with the rights of the server. At most 16. Default `[]`. |
| `preset` | string, may be null | no | Filter preset (`ha`, `cak`, `cah`, `mg`, `na`, `he-d3`, `hbeta`, `white`; see `GET /presets`): its channel and frame share apply wherever `channel` and `keep` are absent, and a `.tif` or `.png` output is coloured with it. Absent: the filter is detected from the file name, folder, sidecar or header, for the settings only. |
| `prominence_band` | integer | no | Pixels outside the fitted limb where alignment points are still allowed; 0 keeps them on the disc. Default `0`. |
| `report` | boolean | no | Make the science report: the frame quality graphs (sorted and in capture order, with the keep threshold), the quality histogram, the global shift and drift and the seeing over the capture, as PNG with their data as CSV and JSON, and one self-contained HTML page. Turns the seeing probe on (about 120 more frames are read). The files are listed in `summary.report`; fetch them with `GET /jobs/{id}/report` and `GET /jobs/{id}/report/{file}`. Default `false`. |
| `robust` | [RobustArg](#robustarg) or null | no |  |
| `robust_k` | number (float), may be null | no | Threshold of `robust` in standard deviations. Default 2.5 for `sigma`, 1.345 for `huber`, 2 for `winsor`. |
| `seeing` | boolean | no | Estimate the seeing from the capture (`summary.seeing`): the Fried parameter from the spectral ratio, which needs `aperture_mm`, and a relative alignment point motion index. Default `false`. |
| `sharpen` | string, may be null | no | Sharpening of the stack: `wavelet` (Registax-style layers, the usual choice), `unsharp`, `rl` (Richardson-Lucy) or `none`, with the recommended values of the filter in force. Absent: `none`. It runs first, on the mono image, before `edits` and before any colour. |
| `sharpen_fits` | boolean | no | Apply `sharpen` and `edits` to FITS output too. By default a FITS file is the unsharpened stack. Default `false`. |
| `sigma_clip` | number (float), may be null | no | Sigma clipping threshold in standard deviations; off when absent. Same as `robust: "sigma"` with `robust_k`. |
| `site` | string, may be null | no | Observing site as `"lat,lon,alt"` (degrees north, degrees east, metres), written to a FITS output as `OBSGEO-X/Y/Z`. Absent: the server's `HELIA_SITE` environment variable, else the keywords are left out. |
| `stack_backend` | string, may be null | no | Stack with this `stack-backend` plugin instead of on the server's own pipeline. Not with `report`, true colour, calibration or field rotation. |
| `sunspots` | [SunspotsConfig](#sunspotsconfig) or null | no |  |
| `wavelets` | string, may be null | no | Wavelets as in RegiStax 6, replacing the recommended layers: the `registax:` form of the CLI's `--wavelets`, for example `registax:l1=100/0.14/0.2,l2=100/0.11/0.15,scheme=dyadic,filter=gaussian`. A layer is `amount/sharpen[/denoise]` (amount 0 to 200 %, sharpen -0.1 to 1, denoise 0 to 1.5); the gain is `1 + amount * sharpen * \|sharpen\|` (0.14 at 100 % is 3x, 1 is 101x) and the noise cut `10 * denoise * amount / 100` noise sigmas. Other keys: `scheme` (`dyadic` or `linear`), `filter` (`default` or `gaussian`), `initial`, `step`, `linked` (`on`). Implies `sharpen: "wavelet"`; with `sharpen: "rl"` the wavelets run after the deconvolution (the usual order: deconvolve, then lift and denoise); excludes `unsharp`. |
| `white_balance` | string, may be null | no | White balance of `colour: "true"`: `auto` (make the disc centre neutral), `off` (the sensor's own balance) or `"R,G,B"` gains such as `"1.9,1,1.5"`. Default `auto`. Only with `colour: "true"`. |

### JobEvent

Message on the `/events` WebSocket.

One of:

* Full job view, sent once on connect. Fields: `job` ([JobView](#jobview)), `type` = `snapshot`.
* State change. Fields: `error` ([ErrorBody](#errorbody) or null), `job` (integer (int64)), `state` ([JobState](#jobstate)), `type` = `state`.
* Progress tick. Fields: `job` (integer (int64)), `progress` (number (float)), `stage_progress` (number (float)), `stage` (string), `type` = `progress`.

### JobRequest

`POST /jobs` body.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | [JobConfig](#jobconfig) | no | Stacking settings. |
| `input` | string | yes | Capture path (`.ser` or `.avi`), relative to the data root. |
| `output` | string | yes | Output path; `.tif`/`.tiff` or `.fits`/`.fit`/`.fts`. |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | Replace an existing output file. |

### JobState

Lifecycle state.

One of `queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`.

| `crop` | [Region](#region) or null | no |  |

| `edits` | array of string | yes | The edits recorded in the output file, one line each. For FITS output without `sharpen_fits` this is the note that the file is unedited. |
| `field_rotation` | [FieldRotationSummary](#fieldrotationsummary) or null | no |  |
| `filter` | string, may be null | no | Preset id in force (chosen or detected), if any. |

| `plugins` | array of [PluginSummary](#pluginsummary) | no | What the `analyse` steps of plugins reported, with `plugin_steps` set. |
| `registered` | integer | yes | Frames registered. |
| `report` | [ReportSummary](#reportsummary) or null | no |  |
| `seeing` | [SeeingSummary](#seeingsummary) or null | no |  |
| `sharpen_check` | [SharpenCheckSummary](#sharpenchecksummary) or null | no |  |
| `stacked_by` | string, may be null | no | The `stack-backend` plugin that made the stack, with `stack_backend` set. |
| `sunspots` | [SunspotsSummary](#sunspotssummary) or null | no |  |
| `true_colour` | [TrueColourSummary](#truecoloursummary) or null | no |  |

### LimbSummary

A limb-darkening law fitted to the stack's azimuthal median profile.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coefficients` | array of number (float) | yes | The coefficients, `I(mu) / I(1) = 1 - sum c_k (1 - mu^k)` for `neckel`, `1 - u (1 - mu) - u2 (1 - mu)^2` for the others. |
| `law` | string | yes | `linear`, `quadratic` or `neckel`. |
| `limb_level` | number (float) | yes | The law at the limb as a share of the disc centre. |
| `names` | array of string | yes | Names of the coefficients, in order (`u1`, `u2`, or `a1` to `a5`). |
| `radius_px` | number (float) | yes | Fitted disc radius, pixels. |
| `rms` | number (float) | yes | Root mean square departure of the profile from the law, as a share of the centre intensity. |
| `text` | string | yes | The fit in a sentence. |

`POST /mosaic` body.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `derotate` | [DerotateConfig](#derotateconfig) or null | no |  |

| `r0_cm` | number (float), may be null | no | Fried parameter at the capture's wavelength, centimetres. |
| `tiles` | integer | yes | Tiles of the disc followed. |

### SunspotsConfig

Tuning of the sunspot detection; every field is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `celestial_north_up` | boolean | no | The image has celestial north up: add the position angle P of the Sun at the capture time to `north_angle_deg`. Default `false`. |
| `group_gap_deg` | number (float), may be null | no | Spots closer than this on the Sun, degrees, form one group. Default 3. |
| `max_area` | number (float), may be null | no | Largest spot, millionths of the hemisphere; bigger dark regions are left out as a cloud or vignette. Default 6000. |
| `min_area` | number (float), may be null | no | Smallest spot, millionths of the hemisphere. Default 2. |
| `mirror` | boolean | no | The image is a mirror image. Default `false`. |
| `north_angle_deg` | number (float), may be null | no | Counter-clockwise angle from the top of the image to solar north, degrees. Default 0. |
| `penumbra` | number (float), may be null | no | Penumbra threshold, a share of the quiet disc (0 to 1). Default 0.88. |
| `umbra` | number (float), may be null | no | Umbra threshold, a share of the quiet disc (0 to 1). Default 0.55. |
| `wolf_k` | number (float), may be null | no | Observer factor k of the Wolf number. Default 1. |

### TimelapseFrame

One frame of a finished time-lapse.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `derotated_px` | number (float), may be null | no | The most the derotation moved the surface of this frame, pixels, when it ran. |
| `file` | string | yes | The frame file, relative to the data root. |
| `frame` | integer | yes | Position in the sequence, from 1. |
| `gain` | number (float) | yes | Gain applied for the brightness (1 without `deflicker`). |
| `input` | string | yes | The input it came from. |
| `limb_confidence` | number (float), may be null | no | Confidence of the frame's limb fit, 0 to 1, when it has one. |
| `method` | string | yes | `reference`, `limb`, `limb+phase`, `phase` or `failed`. |
| `phase_psr` | number (float), may be null | no | Peak-to-sidelobe ratio of the phase correlation, when it ran. |
| `shift_x` | number (float) | yes | Shift applied, pixels (the frame's content was at the reference plus this). |
| `shift_y` | number (float) | yes | Shift applied, pixels. |
| `time` | string, may be null | no | Capture time, UTC, when known. |

### TimelapseRequest

`POST /timelapse` body.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crop` | boolean | no | Cut every frame to the area all of them cover. |
| `deflicker` | string, may be null | no | `off` (default), `match` or `smooth`. |
| `deflicker_window` | integer, may be null | no | Frames in the running median of `smooth` (odd, at least 3; default 5). |
| `derotate` | [DerotateConfig](#derotateconfig) or null | no |  |
| `format` | string, may be null | no | Frame format: `png` (8-bit, default) or `tiff` (16-bit). |
| `fps` | number (float), may be null | no | Frames a second of the movie (default 10, up to 120). |
| `inputs` | array of string | yes | Stacked images, relative to the data root, one per frame (2 to 200). They are put in time order when every one has a time. |
| `max_refine_px` | number (float), may be null | no | Largest correction in pixels the refinement may make (default 3). |
| `movie` | string, may be null | no | `auto` (default: MP4 when ffmpeg is installed, else an animated PNG), `mp4`, `apng` or `none`. |
| `output` | string | yes | Directory for the frames, the movie and the table, relative to the data root. Created when missing. |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | Replace an earlier time-lapse in `output`. |
| `reference` | string, may be null | no | The frame the others are registered to: `first`, `middle` (default) or a number counting from 1. |
| `refine` | boolean, may be null | no | Refine the limb shift by phase correlation of the disc centre (default true). |
| `report` | boolean | no | Also write the diagnostics of the series into `output/report/`: how each frame was registered, the brightness before and after `deflicker`, and the derotation displacement, as PNG, CSV and JSON and one self-contained `report.html` (`summary` `report`). |
| `times` | array of string, may be null | no | UTC capture time of each input (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss`), in the order given in `inputs`. Without it a FITS file's `DATE-AVG` or a file name that holds a full date and time is used; frames with no time are kept in the order given. |

### TimelapseResponse

What a time-lapse made.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crop` | [Region](#region) or null | no |  |
| `frames` | array of [TimelapseFrame](#timelapseframe) | yes | The frames in order. |
| `height` | integer | yes | Height of the written frames. |
| `movie` | string, may be null | no | The movie file, relative to the data root, when one was made. |
| `movie_kind` | string, may be null | no | `mp4` or `apng`. |
| `notes` | array of string | yes | Plain-language lines: what registration did, and any caveat. |
| `reference` | integer | yes | The reference frame, from 1. |
| `report` | string, may be null | no | The diagnostics page (`report.html`), relative to the data root, with `report`; its figures and data are beside it. |
| `table` | string | yes | The registration table (CSV), relative to the data root. |
| `width` | integer | yes | Width of the written frames. |
